report.summary: tests/test_context_plan_latent.py: Tests for the latent context planning subsystem, verifying behavior when latent is off, on with answering backend, unreachable, broken index, and fusion arithmetic.
risks: CLAIMS|tests/test_context_plan_latent.py|The latent half of the context planner must be visible, not merely optional.
